messages:
Lena: Quick sync: after flipping admission into adapters we observed simultaneous heavy KV warmups for same tenant from multiple adapters.
Diego: Yep. Root cause: optimistic ACCEPT + no coordination on who performs warmup. Warmup is expensive and non-idempotent today.
Priya: Need a cheap coordination primitive that doesn't add RPC to every enqueue.
Lena: Proposal: three-path approach. Fast optimistic accept (no RPC). If adapter intends heavy work it must RegisterClaim (tiny in-memory op on shard leader).
Diego: RegisterClaim returns OK|CONFLICT|DEFER with optional claim_id and ttl. OK means start warmup; CONFLICT means abort.
Omar: Keep RegisterClaim low-cost by consistent-hashing tenant to shard so calls hit same leader. Shard registry is in-memory.
Jules: Heartbeats extend claim TTL. If heartbeats stop, scheduler releases claim and another adapter can take over.
Priya: Adapter sends ExtendClaim(claim_id, progress) periodically; that also signals progress percentage. Scheduler can use that to decide preemption.
Lena: If two adapters fast-accept and both RegisterClaim concurrently, one gets OK, other gets CONFLICT and must cancel its warmup. So warmup must be cancellable and idempotent.
Diego: To avoid RegisterClaim hotspots, shard strongly and make the payload minimal (single-byte status). DEFER includes retry_after_ms so adapters back off with jitter.
Omar: Edge-case: leader failover while claim exists. Make claim include shard_epoch; on failover claims invalidated; adapters see not_found on ExtendClaim and retry registration.
Jules: Metrics to add: claim_attempts, claim_conflicts, claim_deferred, warmup_cancels, claim_ttl_extends, heartbeat_misses. Gate rollout on claim_conflicts and client 5xx.
Priya: API sketch: RegisterClaim(tenant_id, host_epoch, expected_work_units)-> {status, claim_id?, ttl_ms?, retry_after_ms?}; ExtendClaim(claim_id, progress)-> {ok|not_found}; ReleaseClaim(claim_id)->{ok}.
Lena: Small optimization: very small warmups (< N keys) can be allowed locally without RegisterClaim; mark them as cheap in metrics.
Diego: Integration tests: race RegisterClaim, leader failover during warmup, DEFER storm backoff.
infra-bot: deploy-batcher v2.3 rolling to staging. CI: https://ci.internal/release/4320010000
Lena: Action items: Diego/Omar design proto + registry, Priya/Jules implement adapter fastpath + cancelable warmup, Ill add integration tests and ops doc. Draft RFC incoming.
